definition: Quantum physics, a quantum phenomenon, a quantum system, or a quantum technology is central to the paper rather than merely mentioned.
container_title_patterns: ^(?:technical program|journal of selected topics|focus issue introduction|proceedings\b|front matter|table of contents|editorial:|preface\b)
notes: Explicit-quantum, intrinsically-quantum, and high-confidence derived paper-keyword routes are accepted automatically.
The lower-confidence derived-keyword tier is retrieval-only unless the paper title independently matches a quantum pattern and is not a container title.
Derived keyword IDs come from the configured frequency, cross-topic, specificity, and quantum-pattern gates; they are not a hand-written search list.

A derived-keyword-only work whose primary OpenAlex topic is in a safeguarded domain is accepted only with a strong title/abstract quantum signal and at least two independently quantum-matching OpenAlex paper keywords.
Broad-related routes include taxonomy-keyword-only and conditional-domain topic matches.
A taxonomy keyword describes a topic cluster and is not assumed to describe every paper assigned to that topic.
The filter is a deterministic retrieval rule, not a trained classifier.
